summary: Eagle Point Income Co Inc. filed a Form 8-K under Item 8.01 to disclose management's unaudited estimate of the net asset value per share of its common stock as of April 30, 2026, ranging between $12.48 and $12.58. This is a routine NAV disclosure for a closed-end investment company, not a special situation. The filing includes no transaction terms, board recommendations, or structural changes. No deal exists; the filing is purely informational, with no risk-arb angle or event-driven opportunity.
